reasons.claim: Four «ح» branches each give the compiler's shaykh and his teacher.
reasons.quote: ح وحدثنا أبو بكر بن، أبي شيبة حدثنا حسين بن علي، عن زائدة

reasons.claim: The text writes the tail once for all branches, so every route ends with Abu Hazim then Sahl b. Sa'd, as both readers expand it.
reasons.quote: كلهم عن أبي حازم، عن سهل بن سعد

reasons.claim: The words after the tail are a remark on wording, not a route.
reasons.quote: يزيد بعضهم على بعض غير أن في حديث زائدة

reasons.claim: Hammad b. Isa tells of an encounter in which the Imam speaks, so the Imam is the last link after Hammad (ruling 9).
reasons.quote: رُوِيَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى أَنَّهُ قَالَ: قَالَ لِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ

reasons.claim: The rest is the scene and the Imam's words, adding no link.
reasons.quote: ثُمَّ قَالَ «يَا حَمَّادُ هَكَذَا صَلِّ.

reviews.question: the Prophet speaking a one-sentence report with no transmitter

reasons.claim: The report is a bare saying with no transmitter before it, so it has no isnad, as both readers say.
reasons.quote: حُبُّكَ لِلشَّيْءِ يُعْمِي وَ يُصِمُّ

reasons.claim: The stored chain is the saying itself, not a name.
reasons.quote: حبك للشيء يعمي و يصم

reasons.claim: The chain runs in order through five named transmitters to the Companion, who relays from the Prophet.
reasons.quote: عن ربيعة بن يزيد، عن عبد الرحمن بن أبي عميرة، وكان، من أصحاب

reasons.claim: The stored chain wrongly stops before the last link the text names.
reasons.quote: ربيعة بن يزيد

reasons.claim: The compiler's grading after the saying is not a link.
reasons.quote: قال أبو عيسى هذا حديث حسن غريب

reviews.question: a fully written chain after the text ending «مثله» / «نحوه» (working rule 11)

reasons.claim: The first isnad has two co-transmitters at the first level and two at the third.
reasons.quote: حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي (رحمه الله) تَعَالَى وَ جَمَاعَةُ مَشَايِخِي عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

reasons.claim: A fully written second isnad after the text ends «مثله» and is a route of this saying under working rule 11, as both readers write it.
reasons.quote: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ وَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ جَمِيعاً

reasons.claim: The bare «الحسن» stays as written between «أبيه» and Fadala.
reasons.quote: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ

reviews.uncertainty_note: If rule 11 were rejected the second group would be a remark, leaving only the first isnad's four routes.

reasons.claim: Muhammad b. Qays relays from Abu Ja'far, whose words the report gives.
reasons.quote: رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ

reasons.claim: The judgment of Amir al-Mu'minin is the content Abu Ja'far tells, not a further link.
reasons.quote: قَضَى أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فِي امْرَأَةٍ

reasons.claim: The single chain runs through eight transmitters to Ibn Umar, who quotes the Prophet.
reasons.quote: عن يزيد بن أبي زياد، عن مجاهد، عن ابن عمر قال: قال رسول الله

reasons.claim: The words between dashes describe Mas'ud and are no link; the stored second branch that drops Mas'ud is wrong.
reasons.quote: مسعود بن سعد الجعفي - وكان من خيار من أدركنا -

reviews.question: a fully written chain after the text ending «مثله» / «نحوه» (working rule 11)

reasons.claim: The first chain is Makki, Abd Allah b. Sa'id, his father, Ibn Abbas; the «هو» clause is a gloss.
reasons.quote: أخبرنا عبد الله بن سعيد  هو ابن أبي هند  عن أبيه، عن ابن عباس

reasons.claim: The second chain after the saying writes its own transmitters and ends «مثله», so it is a route under working rule 11.
reasons.quote: قال عباس العنبري حدثنا صفوان بن عيسى، عن عبد الله بن سعيد بن أبي هند، عن أبيه، سمعت ابن عباس

reviews.uncertainty_note: If rule 11 were rejected the al-Anbari chain would be a remark and only the first route would stand.

reasons.claim: Two co-transmitters joined by «جميعا» both relay from the Imam.
reasons.quote: رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ وَ اَلْحَلَبِيُّ جَمِيعاً عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ

reasons.claim: The two askers in the dialogue are the same two narrators and add no link.
reasons.quote: فَقَالاَ لَهُ فَمَا اَلَّذِي اِشْتَرَطَ عَلَيْهِمْ

reasons.claim: The chain runs through Salim to Abd Allah b. Umar, who relays Umar's account.
reasons.quote: أنه سمع عبد الله بن عمر، يحدث أن عمر بن الخطاب، رضى الله عنه حدثنا

reasons.claim: Umar is the last link because the report relays his words; the stored chain stops before him.
reasons.quote: قال عمر فأتيت عثمان بن عفان

reasons.claim: Uthman and Abu Bakr appear only in the story and are not links.
reasons.quote: فلقيني أبو بكر فقال
